purpose: Owner-approved Meshy 7 ordered-multiview fleet retexture using the successful Kestrel/Palisade route and brighter-than-Palisade tonal authority for the remaining fourteen classes
authorization: Owner approved the Palisade multiview calibration and directed the remaining fleet to use brighter dominant values than Palisade blue.

materialPolicy.sourceDirection: muted powder-coated metal and technical ceramic with satin roughness, oxidized hardware, restrained wear, and no toy gloss, neon, pastel, or near-black dominant hulls
materialPolicy.transformEffect: The deterministic value lift changes RGB tone only; it adds no saturation, synthetic highlight, reflection, or gloss cue.
materialPolicy.enforcement: Only the pinned four-view matte/satin V7 derivatives are submitted; the retexture request contains no competing text-style input.

transform.rationale: Lift shadows and midtones above approved Palisade while preserving near-white highlights and reducing contrast rather than increasing saturation.

brightnessPolicy.enforcement: Every remaining front-right-oblique style derivative must have a measured object median above Palisade before submission.
